mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) while prochlorperazine increases risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, particularly in the setting of electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) closely and obtain baseline and periodic ECGs; consider alternative antiemetic if possible; correct electrolyte abnormalities promptly.
